英語文 · 國三上學期 · 章節筆記

關係代名詞受格省略與介系詞搭配

When a relative pronoun (who, whom, which, that) functions as the object in a relative clause, it can be omitted in informal English. When a verb in the relative clause requires a preposition, the preposition may appear at the end of the clause, or immediately before the formal relative pronoun (preposition + whom/which; "that" cannot follow a preposition).

章節重點

主格
關係代名詞在子句中當主詞，通常不可省略The boy who lives here is Tom.
受格
限定子句中作受詞時常可省略The book (that) I bought is useful.
介系詞
辨識動詞所需搭配The person (who/whom) I talked to…

示範與推理

比較「The girl who helped me is Amy.」與「The girl whom I helped is Amy.」，何者的關係代名詞可省？並改寫「the chair which I sat on」。

  1. 第一句還原為 The girl helped me.，girl 是 helped 的主詞，所以 who 不可省略。
  2. 第二句還原為 I helped the girl.，girl 是受詞；限定子句可寫 The girl I helped is Amy.，也可使用 who/that。
  3. 椅子的句子可寫 the chair I sat on；若把介系詞提前，則為 the chair on which I sat，此結構不能刪掉 which。

易錯提醒　Never place "that" or "who" directly after a preposition (write "the house in which", never "the house in that"). You cannot omit the relative pronoun when it serves as the subject.

闔上筆記，試著回想

  1. The exciting book ___ you recommended to me yesterday was completely sold out.
    • A．who
    • B．what
    • C．which
    • D．where
  2. Combine two sentences using relative clauses: "This is the company." and "My mother works for it." Show both informal preposition-at-end and formal preposition-first forms.
參考解答與自評

第 1 題　C（which）。The antecedent is an object/thing ("book"), and the relative pronoun functions as the object of "recommended" (which can also be omitted or replaced by "that").

第 2 題　用上方的章節重點自評。寫出答案，標明依據，並核對所用條件、單位或情境是否適合。
